authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current MHCLG Planning Data Local Planning Authority dataset contains administrative boundaries for LPAs in England and exposes exact entity identifiers and boundary geometries; it is suitable as coverage-area evidence once an authoritative slot selector exists. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA entity/reference/name, LAD identifier/name, local-plan/local-plan-boundary reference, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any LPA among the returned official records would therefore be guessing. No coverage_area_id can be bound to the slot; no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
